title: Glory of the Dead
description: After Kodlak Whitemane's death, the Companions hold his funeral at the Skyforge. Eorlund reforges Wuuthrad from its fragments, and the Circle travels to Ysgramor's Tomb to cleanse Kodlak's soul of lycanthropy using a Glenmoril Witch head so he may reach Sovngarde. The player is named the new Harbinger.

base_facts: I am a member of the Circle and Kodlak's shield-brother.
I grieve deeply for Kodlak and wanted him cleansed of the beast blood.
I will not enter the deeper tomb; my grief is too heavy.

FUNERAL: I attended Kodlak's funeral at the Skyforge.
CIRCLE_MEETING: I spoke of Kodlak's wish to be cleansed and the way through Ysgramor's Tomb.
CURE_KODLAK: Kodlak's soul is finally at peace in Sovngarde.
HARBINGER: A new Harbinger has been named to lead the Companions.

base_facts: I am a member of the Circle and a werewolf.
I do not see lycanthropy as a curse the way Kodlak did.
I lit the funeral pyre for Kodlak.

FUNERAL: I lit the flame at Kodlak's funeral.
TOMB_EXPEDITION: I accompanied the new Harbinger into Ysgramor's Tomb.
CURE_KODLAK: Kodlak's wolf spirit has been defeated and his soul is free.
HARBINGER: I acknowledge the new Harbinger and will stay in the tomb a while longer.

base_facts: I am a member of the Circle and a werewolf.
I am terrified of large spiders since Dustman's Cairn.
I cared for Kodlak and wanted to honor his wishes.

TOMB_EXPEDITION: I could not go past the spiders in the tomb and turned back.
HARBINGER: I accept the new Harbinger of the Companions.

base_facts: I was the Harbinger of the Companions.
I wished to be cleansed of my werewolf curse so I could enter Sovngarde.
I knew of a way to cleanse my soul even in death through the Tomb of Ysgramor.

BURIAL_CHAMBER: My ghost appeared near the Flame of the Harbinger and asked for the witch head.
CURE_KODLAK: My wolf spirit was defeated and my soul is finally free to go to Sovngarde.
HARBINGER: I named my successor as the new Harbinger before departing to Sovngarde.

base_facts: I am the smith of the Companions and work at the Skyforge.
I repaired Wuuthrad from its fragments.
Kodlak's funeral flame fueled the rebirth of Wuuthrad.

WUUTHRAD_REFORGED: I have reforged Wuuthrad from all its fragments including Kodlak's secret piece.
CIRCLE_MEETING: I brought the reforged Wuuthrad to the Circle in the Underforge.

beats.comment: Kodlak's funeral at the Skyforge; Aela lights the pyre.
All Wuuthrad fragments collected and given to Eorlund for reforging.
Circle gathers in the Underforge; Eorlund brings reforged Wuuthrad.
Travel to Ysgramor's Tomb; place Wuuthrad on Ysgramor's statue to open the way.
Reach the burial chamber and speak to Kodlak's ghost near the Flame of the Harbinger.
Throw witch head into fire, defeat Kodlak's wolf spirit, and speak to Kodlak one last time.
Kodlak names the player as the new Harbinger and departs to Sovngarde; quest complete.
